note: California State Parks campground on a forested hillside off the Avenue of the Giants just south of Myers Flat; the South Fork of the Eel is a short walk. Most sites are tent-only: of the 120 reservable sites, 32 take a 24-ft rig. Showers are coin-operated. --Claude
summary: Hidden Springs (Humboldt Redwoods SP): seasonal, usually Memorial Day-end of September (opens 05-25 / closes 09-30 written), no current restriction, 2027 season not yet loaded on RC; $35 (Saturday the same); 154 sites, 24-ft max, but 87 of 120 bookable units are tent-only - only 32 standard sites take a 24-ft rig; no hookups, flush toilets, pay showers, water, no dump; not waterfront confirmed; pin inside the campground's spread.
flags: SITES: 87 of the 120 web-bookable units are 'Tent Only Site'; 32 standard sites take a 24-ft rig (#22 is 20 ft). Still a real RV campground, but the RV share is small.
MAX STAY: park page 'Maximum allowable stay in individual campsites is 15 nights'; ReserveCalifornia caps May 2027 bookings at 7 nights. Not written as a field.

PIN: the campground spreads ~1.5 km north-south (RC facility points 40.2854, 40.2796, 40.2722); the stored 40.2769,-123.8658 is inside that spread and under full canopy - no move (unit-weighted centroid ~40.2798,-123.8648, ~330 m north, if a centroid is preferred).
STATUS: no unit has 2027 nights through the 2027-05-26 window end; the season loads later. Off-season now, not a closure.
